title: Integrate the Beetle Face and Striped Burglar Costume
objective: Turn the accepted primitive beetle into a more coherent, readable low-poly criminal protagonist by integrating its eyes into the head/mask and adding a bold striped thorax costume without changing locomotion or gameplay.
acceptance: EyeLeft and EyeRight are stable mesh-bearing descendants of Head or Mask, separated and bright or emissive enough to read as inset face openings rather than floating blocks
the mesh-bearing Head and dark burglar Mask remain coherent, forward-facing, low-poly, and immediately legible as a criminal bug face
a mesh-bearing Shirt hierarchy is centered around the thorax and contains at least three broad named Stripe meshes with strong light/dark contrast
the sleeveless costume preserves visible insect segmentation, all six leg attachments, both antennae, squat posture, and a clearly non-humanoid dung beetle silhouette
all character construction remains deterministic and uses only supported low-segment Godot primitive meshes with no external model, texture, rig, or animation dependency
the dark shell, bright face accents, and striped costume improve readability against neon magenta/purple environments at normal gameplay distance
TB-R03A grounded gait, leg and body articulation, camera-relative movement, controller, collision, interaction, gameplay loop, and all three levels remain unchanged
TB-001 through TB-R03A regressions, normal and close rendered evidence, Linux export, and exported runtime for all levels pass
the change remains within scenes/player.tscn and scripts/player.gd and introduces no gameplay, audio, stealth, door, trap, or power-up system
